rule: unique Earth windows that are a top-3 twin of a Mars or Moon target or of a Mars atlas cell; new = not inside a known analog region (circle approximation); unclassified = no novelty (not counted as new)
place_rule: place_counts count Earth PLACES: a refined window '<target>__pool__pool_N' is the same place as 'pool__pool_N' (re-centred by a few km). A place whose windows differ in novelty is 'mixed'. Use place_counts for public figures; counts (by window) are kept for tracing.
